summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests AVZO-023, an oral CDK4 inhibitor, alone and with AVZO-021 (an oral CDK2 inhibitor) and/or endocrine therapy, in advanced solid tumors, including HR+/HER2- breast cancer. AVZO-023 is taken by mouth twice daily in 28-day cycles, with escalating doses; the total length of treatment is not stated. The study aims to measure safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, maximum tolerated dose, and anti-tumor effects.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AVZO-023, un inhibidor oral de CDK4, solo y combinado con AVZO-021 (un inhibidor oral de CDK2) y/o terapia endocrina, en tumores sólidos avanzados, incluido el cáncer de mama HR+/HER2-. AVZO-023 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en ciclos de 28 días, con dosis crecientes; la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio busca medir la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, la farmacocinética, la farmacodinamia, la dosis máxima tolerada y los efectos antitumorales.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 1 and life expectancy over 3 months.
Advanced solid tumor with histologic or cytologic proof of malignancy.
Adequate kidney, liver, and bone marrow function.
Agrees to provide molecular test results and archival tumor sample or fresh biopsy.
Measurable disease is preferred in dose escalation; bone-only disease is allowed in dose escalation.
not_for: Prior treatment with a selective investigational CDK2, CDK4, or CDK2/4/6 inhibitor.
Known active brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Other invasive cancer, or one treated within 3 years before first dose, with listed exceptions.
History of drug-induced pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease.
Confirmed loss-of-function mutation or deletion of the RB1 gene.
